start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me the numbered segments of plan p1, then regroup it as one new lead line followed by segments 1 and 0." It runs outline, then regroup.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads and rewrites the plan files in the folder you name.
instructions: 1. Clone the Workshop checkout; only python3 is needed.
2. Say "Outline plan p1"; the AI runs python3 tools/assemble-a-plan-into-a-cut/do-work/assemble.py outline --request outline.json with plan_files naming your plan.
3. Write regroup.json: plans_folder and shapes {slug: {head, groups: [{lead, members, member_kind, labels}], tail}}; every segment with a recording must be used once.
4. Say "Regroup it"; the AI runs the regroup step and shows each group's recorded seconds. The plan file is rewritten.

worked_examples.title: Outline a plan, then regroup it under a new lead
worked_examples.ask: Show me the numbered segments of plan p1, then regroup it.
worked_examples.given: From test_outline_numbers_the_segments and test_regroup_builds_lead_and_members_and_uses_every_clip_once in tools/assemble-a-plan-into-a-cut/test/test_assemble.py, run here: plan p1 (id X1, title Old Name) has reply a 0-2 s labelled old, reply b 1-4 s, and the note 'Then: Old Name'. Shape: groups [{lead: {kind ask, text 'A made-up lead?'}, members [1, 0], member_kind reply, labels {"0": "new"}}], tail [2]; structure 'made-up note'.
worked_examples.hands_back: outline printed {"result": {"plans": [{"slug": "p1", "id": "X1", "title": "Old Name", "recorded_seconds": 5, "segments": [{i 0, kind reply, clip a, seconds 2}, {i 1, kind reply, clip b, seconds 3}, {i 2, kind note, seconds null}]}]}}. regroup printed {"result": {"plans": [{"slug": "p1", "groups": 1, "group_seconds": [5], "segments": 4}]}} and p1.json now holds ask, reply b, reply a (label new, its old label replaced), the note, with structure 'made-up note'. Leaving a clip out is refused: 'segments with a clip must be used exactly once'.
